howto: Slide your finger or the mouse to move the square bucket.
A quick tap (or Space) changes the bucket's colour; the dots at the bottom show the cycle.
Catch balls that match the bucket's colour.
20 good catches wins. Catching the wrong colour 3 times ends the run.
tips: Letting a wrong-coloured ball fall past is free; only catching it counts against you.
Switch colour before you slide under a ball, not while it is landing.
Balls bounce off the side walls, so watch their angle.
Long slides don't change colour: only a short tap does.

controls.keyboard: Mouse to move, Space to change colour. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Slide to move the bucket; tap to change colour. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy allows 5 wrong catches with slower, fewer balls; Normal 3; Hard 2 wrong catches with faster, more frequent balls.

cheats.effect: Wrong catches no longer count against you

features.one-tap-start: Tap or press Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the result card
features.best-score-badge: BEST x/20 under the catch counter
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated drag; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: TOO MANY WRONG! card with catches and best, or PERFECT MATCH!
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-color-match blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)
